about: Slab looks (custom geometry plan, stage M5): each a fracturing floor or roof of the game's that the Build makes slabs in, and what was measured on it (research/evidence/slab-audit.py; tools/bake/frac_slab.py builds a slab from it). A slab's numbers name their look (`look`; left out, the first). Heights are in the donor mesh's frame; texture coordinates are u = sx * x / repeat + du, v = sy * y / repeat + dv on the top and the underside; the edges are in the top's slot.

looks.name: Roof
looks.words: a flat roof: gravel and asphalt on top, ceiling tiles under it

looks.name: Upper floor
looks.words: a storey floor: dark brown floor tiles on top, butcher's tiles under it
